note: RESEARCHED, NOT CLIENT-SUPPLIED. Every summary below is written by us from published sources (publisher listings, trade press, network announcements) and paraphrased — no jacket copy is reproduced. Facts (publisher, imprint, year, network, collaborators) are cited in `sources`. This file is deliberately separate from site.json, which holds RG's verbatim copy: nothing here goes on the site until RG signs it off. `roleBasis` says how we know RG's role — 'client-copy' means his own approved bio states it, 'imprint' means the publisher is verified and his bio states his job there, 'unconfirmed' means ask him. Compiled 2026-09-18; six further titles added the same day at the client's instruction, marked onSite:false — they are named in RG's bio but have no tile, and cannot get one until a cover image and a proof line exist for each. 2026-10-21: three of those six went on the site with the covers and proof lines he sent — THE GREENPRINT, THE NEXT BIG STORY, and Mottola's, now titled HITMAKER at his word — with three new entries beside them (ROOTS OF STYLE, EXTRA LEAN, MAKE IT REALITY); the other three still wait.

drive.summary: Swizz Beatz and his eldest son, Nasir Dean, travel to Los Angeles, New York, Houston, Atlanta, Japan and Saudi Arabia to meet the people who build, race and collect cars, and to bring separate car communities together around the same obsession.
drive.carrier: Hulu, for Onyx Collective — six episodes, premiered 16 November 2023
drive.award: Won the 2024 Daytime Emmy for Outstanding Single Camera Editing; also nominated for Outstanding Sound Mixing and Sound Editing
drive.confirm: Do you want the Emmy named by category — 'Outstanding Single Camera Editing, 2024 Daytime Emmy Awards' — or left as 'Emmy Award-Winning'?
drive.awardShort: Daytime Emmy — Outstanding Single Camera Editing

time-of-essence.summary: Five hours on fifty years of Essence, a decade to an episode — how the magazine reported and shaped Black American culture, told by the people who were in it. With Oprah Winfrey, Halle Berry, Whoopi Goldberg, Taraji P. Henson, Regina Hall, Taye Diggs, Gabrielle Union and Beverly Johnson.

remix-my-space.summary: Marsai Martin and a design team surprise teenagers who have done something for their community, and rebuild their bedrooms around what each of them actually cares about — photography, robotics, sneakers.

behind-the-vegas-residency.summary: A backstage hour on Ricky Martin's 'All In' residency at the Park Theater in Las Vegas — rehearsals, career flashbacks and the days before opening night.

true-love.summary: Lopez's first book: a diary of the two years after she and Marc Anthony separated, begun on her Dance Again world tour, in which she rebuilt both her life and her work. A portion of the proceeds goes to the Lopez Family Foundation.
true-love.carrier: Celebra | Penguin — published in English and Spanish, 4 November 2014

me.summary: Martin's memoir — a childhood in Puerto Rico, the Menudo years, the scale of 'Livin' la Vida Loca', coming to terms with his sexuality, and becoming a father.
me.carrier: Celebra | Penguin — published as ME and YO, 2 November 2010

the-love-playbook.summary: Anthony's rules for dating, relationships and holding on to yourself inside one, drawn from her own life. Written with Karen Hunter; it reached No. 1 on the New York Times advice list.

my-voice.summary: Two decades of hip-hop radio from the inside: an internship at Hot 97, her 'Battle of the Beats' segment, and the long interview she did with Tupac Shakur at twenty-five, most of which never aired. Foreword by J. Cole.

estefan-kitchen.summary: Cuban home cooking from the Estefans and the kitchen of their Bongos Cuban Café — tapas, family-style plates, desserts and the cocktails that go with them.

a-memoir.summary: Moreno's account of the journey from a Puerto Rican childhood and the Bronx to Broadway at thirteen and Hollywood in its golden age — and of becoming one of the very few performers to hold an Oscar, a Grammy, a Tony and two Emmys.

to-selena-with-love.summary: Selena's husband and guitarist on their life together — how they met in her band, the marriage, and her death — written seventeen years afterwards.
to-selena-with-love.carrier: Celebra | Penguin — 6 March 2012; a commemorative edition followed

why-soccer-matters.summary: Pelé on six decades of the game, built around five World Cups, and on what the sport did for lives far away from the pitch. Written with Brian Winter.

out-of-the-blue.summary: The route from Paterson, New Jersey to a Super Bowl-winning Giants side, and the family who made it possible — a grandmother who gave him the salsa celebration, a firefighter father who taught him the game, a mother who would not let him stop. Written with Peter Schrager.
out-of-the-blue.carrier: Celebra | Penguin — 17 July 2012; a young readers' edition followed

the-22-day-revolution.summary: A twenty-two day plant-based programme from the exercise physiologist behind 22 Days Nutrition, built on the idea that a habit takes three weeks to form. Foreword by Beyoncé, introduction by Dr Dean Ornish.
the-22-day-revolution.confirm: Your bio names a different Borges title — THE GREENPRINT — as a Major Content literary-representation credit. Both are real. Do you want THE GREENPRINT on the site as well, or instead of this one?

chasing-the-sun.summary: An illustrated autobiography: growing up in Medellín through the most violent years of Colombia's recent history, co-founding the rock band Ekhymosis as a teenager, and the faith and music that carried him out.

im-not-gonna-lie.summary: Lopez on turning fifty, played for comedy — dating much younger, losing the fight to stay in shape, a session with a pet psychic — and, underneath it, his kidney disease and transplant. Written with Alan Eisenstock.

chords-of-strength.summary: The American Idol runner-up on the vocal cord paralysis he had to overcome to keep singing, and the faith he leaned on doing it. Written with Monica Haim.

growing-stronger.summary: The singer and telenovela star on the things she does not usually discuss: her father's death when she was five, the kidnapping of two of her sisters, and the illness that changed her life — set against her marriage to Tommy Mottola and their daughter.

clemente.summary: Roberto Clemente told by his own family: Puerto Rico to the major leagues, eighteen seasons and three thousand hits, and the relief flight to earthquake victims in Nicaragua on which he died.

celia-my-life.summary: The Queen of Salsa's life in her own words, drawn from interviews recorded in her final months — Havana and La Sonora Matancera, the exile that followed, and Pedro Knight. Written with Ana Cristina Reymundo.
celia-my-life.confirm: HIS ROLE HERE IS NOT THE RAYO JOB. Publishers Weekly (20 September 2004) reports he started at Rayo ON 20 September 2004, in the new position of associate publisher, coming from REG. CELIA: MY LIFE was reviewed by PW on 21 June 2004 and published that July — roughly two months before he arrived. So the imprint inference does not hold for this title and the role is off the site until he says what it should be. His bio does say that at REG he 'grew the Celia Cruz license into a perennial International property', which may be the actual connection. Ask him.
needs: RG to confirm his role on this title

lord-help-me.summary: A picture book of everyday prayers by Muñiz, written at twelve — waking up for school, getting along with a sibling, and looking after endangered animals. Illustrated by Brenda Figueroa, published in English and Spanish.
lord-help-me.carrier: Crown Books for Young Readers | Random House Children's Books — 29 September 2020

noelle-the-bulldog.summary: Estefan's first children's book. An adopted bulldog is sure she is too odd-looking and too short-legged for her new home, and finds out that everyone has something worth having. Illustrated by Michael Garland.
noelle-the-bulldog.role: Associate Publisher and Marketing Director, Rayo

mud-tacos.summary: A brother and sister make wormy, squirmy mud tacos in their nana's backyard, which gives them the idea of making real ones. By Mario Lopez and his sister Marissa Lopez Wong, illustrated by Maryn Roos; published in English and Spanish.

santiago-the-dreamer.summary: A boy who wants nothing more than to be on a stage doesn't get the lead in the school play. His father's answer is what gets his confidence back. Illustrated by Patricia Castelao.

the-greenprint.summary: Twenty-two laws for eating plants, with more than sixty recipes and the exercise and lifestyle habits meant to go with them. Introduction by Jay-Z and Beyoncé.
the-greenprint.note: Named in RG's bio as a Major Content representation credit — since 2026-10-21 in the literary-representation line he asked for in bold. Harmony, not Celebra — which is consistent: this is the post-Celebra, representation-era Borges title, where THE 22-DAY REVOLUTION was the Celebra one. On the site from 2026-10-21 with the cover and proof line he sent, which he marked big. Summary corrected the same day against the publisher's listing: '22 Laws', 'more than 60' recipes.

the-next-big-story.summary: O'Brien on the stories that made her as a reporter — Hurricane Katrina, the tsunami in Southeast Asia and the earthquake in Haiti — on her CNN documentaries Black in America and Latino in America, and on growing up in a mixed-race family. Written with Rose Marie Arce.
the-next-big-story.note: Full title: THE NEXT BIG STORY: MY JOURNEY THROUGH THE LAND OF POSSIBILITIES. O'Brien is named in RG's bio as a Celebra author. On the site from 2026-10-21 with the cover and proof line he sent.

roots-of-style.summary: Isabel Toledo's memoir — a childhood in Cuba, her marriage to Ruben, and how sewing and craft became a curious girl's way of expressing herself — with a case for trusting your instincts and finding a style of your own. Illustrated throughout by Ruben Toledo.
roots-of-style.note: Added 2026-10-21 with the cover he sent. Full title: ROOTS OF STYLE: WEAVING TOGETHER LIFE, LOVE, AND FASHION. He credits it to 'Isabel and Ruben Toledo' (the jacket: Isabel Toledo, illustrations by Ruben Toledo). He gave no proof line, so the tile has none.

extra-lean.summary: Lopez's plan for eating to burn fat, built on three habits — balancing carbohydrate, protein and fat, keeping portions in check, and eating often through the day — with more than forty recipes and a seven-week meal plan. Written with the trainer Jimmy Peña.
extra-lean.note: Added 2026-10-21 with the cover he sent, which he marked big. Full title: EXTRA LEAN: THE FAT-BURNING PLAN THAT CHANGES THE WAY YOU EAT FOR LIFE. Celebra hardcover 4 May 2010 (ISBN 9780451230164); the paperback followed 3 May 2011.

make-it-reality.summary: Abrego's road from hauling camera gear on Road Rules to making The Surreal Life and Flavor of Love and the top job at Endemol Shine North America — each stage paired with what it taught him about setting goals and taking risks. Foreword by Pitbull.
make-it-reality.note: Added 2026-10-21 with the cover he sent. Full title: MAKE IT REALITY: CREATE YOUR OPPORTUNITY, OWN YOUR SUCCESS. He gave no proof line, so the tile has none — the publisher's page flags it 'Best Seller', but a proof line is his to give. Published by Celebra five months before Publishers Weekly reported Berkley winding the imprint down (3 October 2016), so the imprint basis holds here as it does for the rest of the list.

hitmaker.summary: Mottola's account of the record business, from the Bronx to the head of Sony Music worldwide: the careers he discovered, developed or managed — Mariah Carey, Celine Dion, Shakira, Jennifer Lopez and Gloria Estefan among them — his marriage to Carey, and his power struggle with his mentor Walter Yetnikoff. Written with Cal Fussman.
hitmaker.carrier: Celebra | Penguin — the Spanish edition, EL CREADOR DE ÉXITOS, 5 August 2014
hitmaker.note: Was 'el-creador-de-exitos', parked with the question 'Celebra published the SPANISH edition only — Grand Central had the English. Do you want this tile at all, and if so under which title?' He answered on 2026-10-21: HITMAKER, 'New York Times Bestseller', 'You could put Celebra', with an Amazon link to ISBN 0451241053 — EL CREADOR DE ÉXITOS, Celebra, 5 August 2014 — and its cover as the art. So the publisher line is the Celebra Spanish edition, said outright, never Celebra for the English book: that was Grand Central (29 January 2013), written with Cal Fussman. The Spanish jacket carries 'Autor bestseller en el New York Times de HITMAKER'.

no-lost-causes.title: NO LOST CAUSES
no-lost-causes.summary: The Colombian president's account of his eight years in office: the campaign that broke the FARC, and the 2008 jungle rescue of Íngrid Betancourt.
no-lost-causes.carrier: Celebra | Penguin — 2012; in Spanish as NO HAY CAUSA PERDIDA
no-lost-causes.note: Uribe is named in RG's bio as a Celebra author.

viviendo.title: VIVIENDO
viviendo.summary: The actor and presenter on her childhood in Puerto Rico, her breast cancer, her mother's sudden illness, and the end of her marriage.
viviendo.carrier: Celebra | Penguin — December 2012; the English edition, THRIVING, followed in 2013 with additional material
viviendo.note: Adamari Lopez is named in RG's bio as a Celebra author.

una-vida.title: UNA VIDA
una-vida.summary: The Puerto Rican singer's memoir — a child performer in Ponce who became one of Latin music's lasting voices, and what it cost along the way.
una-vida.confirm: We could not pin the publication year to a source — 2016 is our best reading of the ISBN. Can you confirm it, or shall we leave the year off this one?
una-vida.note: Ednita Nazario is named in RG's bio as a Celebra author. Spanish-language title.
